senses.zh_definition: 未消歧的字母串；在学术写作语境中，大写 MLA 可指美国现代语言协会，也可用于指称该协会制定的论文与引文格式。
senses.en_definition: An unresolved letter string; in academic writing, uppercase MLA can denote the Modern Language Association or its documentation style.
senses.ms_definition: Rentetan huruf yang belum dikenal pasti rujukannya; dalam penulisan akademik, MLA boleh merujuk kepada Modern Language Association atau gaya penulisan dan rujukan yang diterbitkannya.
senses.nuances: 输入没有提供释义或出处，不能将 mla 确认为普通马来语词，也不能确定它就是 MLA。此处词性及以下搭配、例句仅适用于学术缩写这一条件性解释，并非已验证的原语料释义。马来语释义为编辑说明，不是 DBP 原文。机构与格式依据：[MLA Style Center](https://style.mla.org/about-the-mla-style-center/)。

etymology.historical_story: In academic contexts, MLA takes its letters from Modern Language Association, the organization responsible for the MLA Handbook. Its name also identifies a system for presenting research and documenting sources. This explains one established use of the uppercase abbreviation, but it does not establish the origin or intended meaning of the lowercase corpus token supplied here. [Source](https://style.mla.org/about-the-mla-style-center/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 仅在学术语境中记：MLA → Modern Language Association → 论文引文格式；不要把这个解释套用于所有 mla。
